title: Pointing at Things
label: ch:bn-pointing-at-things
canDo: I can point at something near me and something across the room, put a pointer and a classifier on the same phrase, and ask what is this?

payoff.summary: The near and far heads arrive together, stack with the classifier at the opposite end of the phrase, and stand alone as এটা — which with the কী of chapter three makes the commonest beginner question in any language sayable for the first time.
payoff.note: এই and ওই both returned zero matches across 139 lessons before this chapter. A learner could not point at anything.
